verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.bill.com/llms.txt, which says docs pages can be fetched as Markdown by appending .md, matching the many .md doc URLs in the pack. BILL also has a dedicated AI agent resources page and a documentation MCP server for Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for agents (all probed paths returned 404), and the full content of llms.txt (the probe output is truncated).
